reason: Both are fee-earning alternative asset managers selling to institutional investors and wealth managers. The products differ. Cohen & Steers runs listed real assets and alternative income strategies, including REITs, infrastructure, commodities and preferreds, in mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts. Ridgepost runs private markets strategies: private equity funds-of-funds, secondaries, venture capital and private credit in the middle and lower middle market. The customers overlap only partly. Cohen & Steers also sells to individual investors through public funds, while Ridgepost raises capital from LPs and institutions for private funds.
